an_instrument_defect_found_and_repaired.$category: measurement infrastructure, not product — the same category as the D4.32 FIXTURE_PROFILE repair
an_instrument_defect_found_and_repaired.what: knowledge-base/intake/facts/ is a contributed-facts directory that is legitimately EMPTY in the shipped state. Git does not track empty directories, so it did not survive the clone.
who_assumed_it_existed: factRegistry.js — TOLERANT. It treats a missing directory as 'no contributed facts', which is correct.
tests/factAdmission.test.mjs — not tolerant. Wrote a probe file into it and died. 61 checks unavailable.
scripts/proveUniversality.mjs — not tolerant, and worse: see below.
the_worse_case: proveUniversality installs a synthetic family, proves the engine handles it with no code change,
and removes it again. install() was called OUTSIDE its own try/finally, so when the write into
the missing directory threw, teardown never ran and three synthetic artifacts stayed in the
They are not inert. Families are DISCOVERED from knowledge-base/documents, so the residue added
a 41st family whose blueprint had already been deleted — and every later suite that iterates the
population failed for a reason that had nothing to do with it.
One broken probe made fifteen unrelated suites red, and running the same suites in a different
repair: knowledge-base/intake/facts/.gitkeep so the directory survives a clone
proveUniversality: create the directory before writing, and move install() inside the try so teardown is unconditional
an_instrument_defect_found_and_repaired.$the_generalisable_bit: A contract expressed as 'this directory exists' cannot survive a clone when the directory is empty. Anything that WRITES into a knowledge directory must create it, and any probe that mutates the knowledge base must tear down in a finally that its own setup cannot skip.

the_17_are_not_17_causes.$why_this_section_exists: A list of red test names invites one repair per name. Most of these share a cause, and two of them are not defects at all.

dominant_cause.statement: 11 of 40 families produce no draft at all. Every suite that needs a corpus then fails for lack of one.
dominant_cause.$not_a_claim: This does NOT assert that any of those constraints is wrong. A constraint that refuses an affidavit may be refusing correctly; whether it should reach that shape at all is exactly the undecided question.

two_kinds_kept_apart.$why: Folding them together would let 'unencoded constraint scope' take credit for blueprint gaps it had nothing to do with.

SHAPE_MISMATCH_CANDIDATE.description: A constraint written for contracts is refusing a document that is not a contract. CONTRACT_REQUIRES_CONSIDERATION refusing an affidavit is the clearest instance.
SHAPE_MISMATCH_CANDIDATE.owner: advocate — this is the D4.33 scope question, already queued as a row in the constraint scope panel

AGREEMENT_FAMILY_BLOCKED.description: The family IS an agreement, so the constraint may apply perfectly well and the blueprint may simply lack the clause it requires. That is knowledge completeness, not constraint scope.
AGREEMENT_FAMILY_BLOCKED.owner: engine plus knowledge — NOT the advocate queue
AGREEMENT_FAMILY_BLOCKED.$the_one_that_is_neither: PROMISSORY_NOTE is classified AGREEMENT here but is governed by the Negotiable Instruments Act 1881, which treats consideration differently from the Contract Act. Whether it belongs in this group at all is a legal question, and it is NOT asserted either way in this record.

the_17_are_not_17_causes.$do_not_expand_the_queue: These 11 families are CONSEQUENCES of questions already asked, not 11 new questions. D4.33 set that rule for the 342/41 failures and it holds here for the same reason.
the_17_are_not_17_causes.$note_on_the_count: Written when the count was 17; it is 16 after the instrument repair. The attribution below is unaffected — factAdmission was the one that left.

what_this_record_does_not_do: It does not decide any constraint's scope.
It does not assert that any of the 17 failures is acceptable.
It does not claim the 17 are all explained — only the dominant cause is attributed; individual suites may have their own reasons on top.
It does not repair the product. The only repair made was to the measurement instrument, and it is described above so it can be disputed.
